project_info.archetype: Archetype 4/5 Hybrid (Aviation Command Center / Performance Pro)

global_principles: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Command Center functionality.
Aviation-inspired, clean, professional, not flashy. Avoid gradients everywhere.
Prioritize data density, readability, and immediate situational awareness.
Crisp, technical borders. No soft or generic 'Vercel' dropshadows.
All interactive elements must have clear hover and active states.
All key elements must have `data-testid` attributes.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense but clearly separated)
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Padding internally should be generous (p-4 to p-6) but gaps between cards tight (gap-3 or gap-4).
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-md (6px) to maintain a sharp, technical feel.
layout_and_spacing.layout_shell: Sidebar on left (w-64, dark border-r), Navbar on top (h-16, dark border-b), Content area.
layout_and_spacing.card_design: Flat solid backgrounds (no glassmorphism unless sticky header). 1px solid border (border-slate-800). No default shadows; use drop-shadow only for floating elements like popups/dropdowns.

surface_strategies.headers: Solid background matching primary bg, 1px border-b border-slate-800. Sticky top with z-50.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-slate-900), subtle border. Hover state lifts slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) and border turns to border-cyan-500/50.
surface_strategies.modals: Dark slate background, heavy backdrop blur for the overlay (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80).

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-medium hover:bg-cyan-400 transition-colors border border-cyan-400
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:border-slate-500 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-transparent border border-red-900/50 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-colors
buttons.rules: No rounded-full unless specific icon button. Keep corners sharp (rounded-sm).

tables.header: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2

map_guidelines.theme: Dark mode tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter or similar dark tiles).
map_guidelines.markers: Custom SVG markers (Cyan for active, Emerald for idle, Red for alert). Use sharp diamond or triangular aviation shapes instead of default pins.
map_guidelines.polylines: Route paths should be 2-3px Cyan with slight opacity (stroke-cyan-500/70).
map_guidelines.geofence: Circles/Polygons should have dashed borders (stroke-dasharray) with very low fill opacity (fill-orange-500/10, border-orange-500/50).
map_guidelines.popups: Override Leaflet default popup. Dark background (bg-slate-900), sharp corners, 1px border.

icons.usage: Use icons sparingly; pair with text labels to ensure clarity for complex aviation/fleet concepts.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. E.g., data-testid='vehicle-card-123', data-testid='login-submit-button'.

image_urls.description: Aerial view of a city at night. Dark, high-contrast, technical feel suitable for AirSync AI auth page background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT rebuild the routing or API fetching logic. Respect existing data-fetching functions in src/data/*.
Reuse the existing ThemeContext for dark/light toggling, but default styling to the Dark theme variables.
Apply IBM Plex Sans for headings, Manrope for body, JetBrains Mono for data.
Eliminate any generic soft shadows and gradients. Use sharp 1px borders and flat colors.
Enhance hover states. Replace standard dull hovers with crisp Cyan/Slate transitions.
In Dashboards, utilize CSS Grid with gap-4 and make cards stretch completely. Follow 'Control Room' grid rules.
Incorporate the footer 'Made by Preeti Gupta' in the LogisticsLayout.
For empty states and loading states, use JetBrains mono text and subtle pulsing (opacity animations, not spinning loaders if possible).
